title: Load selected matrix sources and compare in one persistent document

verificationRecords.notes: Three checks pass: menu fetch isolation and both accepted explanation preservations. Matrix units 22 pass and production build passes.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:matrix-interpretations -- --grep "persistent comparison|latest matrix|repeated selection"
verificationRecords.notes: Two lifecycle/race checks pass; comparison test tried clicking links intentionally hidden in embedded mode. Test now uses a visible host query to verify preservation without contradicting embedded UI.
All 21 Chromium checks pass. Includes exact URLs, Back/Forward, focus, canceled stale selection, failure rollback, observer disposal and accepted motion.

Selected matrix routes fit the existing 111000-byte JS ceiling. Existing row-guided exceeds its ceiling by 98 bytes; composition union exceeds by 4040 bytes. Diagnose against baseline before any amendment.
One document request, zero requests after warmup, each selected source fetched once. Twelve switches retain 2772 DOM nodes and 30 listeners after GC; heap rises 4.07 to 4.39 MB and is diagnostic.

Complete selected sources and explicit all-source union pass. Baseline1689f1ab1 reproduces pre-existing row overages; review records exact byte changes, unchanged row module sets and bounded policy amendments without dropping consumers.
All architecture, inference, concept/promotion gates and all 7389 repository tests pass. No skipped tests or waived checks.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:matrix-interpretations -- --project=firefox --project=webkit --grep "persistent comparison|latest matrix|repeated selection|failed native preparation|explanation keeps"
verificationRecords.notes: WebKit check assumed pointer clicks focus links; use keyboard activation to test focus preservation. Scoped testDir also now excludes copied specs from scratch worktrees; the initial run included six duplicates, not six extra mechanisms.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:matrix-interpretations -- --project=firefox --project=webkit --grep "persistent comparison|latest matrix|repeated selection|failed native preparation|explanation keeps"
verificationRecords.notes: All 18 canonical checks pass, six each in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Keyboard focus test corrected; scoped testDir excludes scratch-worktree copies.
All app, Node, test, Svelte and domain checks pass. Final test-only adjustment also passes typecheck:tests.
Canonical source freshness checks and production application build pass; selected matrix production build and network fixture also verified separately.

progress.summary: COMPLETE: lazy selected loading, persistent exact-position comparison, history restoration, stale-load prevention and recovery delivered through existing accepted player. All four packages verified; no new aesthetic treatment.
